author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content: Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. We have steady book work planned well beyond this first title: the right illustrator will have ongoing commissions for the foreseeable future. The project: ~640 words, 14 full spreads + cover, 8.5" × 8.5" paperback. Warm, playful, family-centered, told entirely in first-person visuals. We're after soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling; classic picture-book charm with real emotional range. Who we're looking for: An emerging illustrator ready to earn their first picture book credit, or add a strong title to an existing portfolio. You need to draw the same characters, animals, and settings again and again, different scenes, different angles, and keep them recognizable every time. Strong sequential storytelling across full spreads. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones (signing / approved thumbnails & character designs / approved finished illustrations / print-ready delivery). Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. Future books come with paid commissions and the opportunity to negotiate ongoing royalty participation. Prominent cover and title-page credit. Timeline: Hire by November 1, 2026; Thumbnails ~December 15; Finished art ~February 1, 2027; Print-ready ~March 1, 2027. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.) Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST. Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!

author: OC Illustration
title: Looking for live illustrators in Michigan
content: Michigan artists! OC Illustration is looking for live illustrators to join our team! Hi everyone! My name is Olivia, and I own OC Illustration, a live illustration studio based in Michigan. We provide elegant, minimalist fashion-style illustrations at weddings, corporate events, and private celebrations across the Midwest! We’re growing our team and looking for talented, enthusiastic artists to join our small roster of contract illustrators in Michigan. Paid, part-time, contract work. Approximately 2–3 events per month (you build your own schedule!). Most events are 4–6 hours, primarily evenings and weekends. Events throughout Michigan, with potential opportunities in surrounding states. Training to learn our signature OC Illustration style and workflow. No prior live event experience required! Who we're looking for: Artists with strong foundational drawing and gesture skills. Someone who is comfortable working with markers or alcohol markers. A fast learner who is open to learning our specific illustration style. Someone personable, reliable, and comfortable interacting with guests. Our goal is to create beautiful, timeless illustrations that guests can take home as a meaningful keepsake. During training, you'll learn how to create our signature portraits in approximately 5–10 minutes! If you're looking for a creative side gig and love drawing people, I'd love to connect with you! Interested? Comment or fill out the application below! Check out our work: https://www.ocillustration.com/workwithus Feel free to share this with any Michigan artists who might be a great fit!
